headline: A quiet Monday for your teams, with Arsenal v Borussia Dortmund at 3:00 PM and England's second T20I in Australia at 3:15 AM both on Tuesday.
today: No Tier 1 events today; the next are Tuesday's England T20I (3:15 AM, Willow) and Arsenal v Borussia Dortmund (3:00 PM, Paramount+).

recaps.text: Gerwyn Price beat Gian van Veen 16-11 in the Grand Slam of Darts final to win his first major in four years and move up to world No 3.
Carlos Alcaraz beat top seed Alexander Zverev 6-2 7-6 in the ATP Finals final in Turin, winning the season-ending event for the first time.

lookAhead: Thursday's third T20I and Saturday's England v New Zealand Nations Championship game (11:40 AM) lead into Sunday 29 November, with Arsenal v Manchester City at 11:30 AM and the Jets at the Dolphins at 1:00 PM.
